mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.user_id, t.transaction_date, t.merchant, t.category_id, c.name AS category_name, t.amount, t.card_name, t.installment, t.status, t.memo FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.transaction_date DESC, t.id DESC

SELECT t.id, t.user_id, t.transaction_date, t.merchant, t.category_id, c.name AS category_name, t.amount, t.card_name, t.installment, t.status, t.memo FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions (user_id, transaction_date, merchant, category_id, amount, card_name, installment, status, memo) VALUES (#{userId}, CAST(#{transactionDate} AS DATE), #{merchant}, #{categoryId}, #{amount}, #{cardName}, #{installment}, #{status}, #{memo})
mapper.update: UPDATE transactions SET transaction_date = CAST(#{transactionDate} AS DATE), merchant = #{merchant}, category_id = #{categoryId}, amount = #{amount}, card_name = #{cardName}, installment = #{installment}, status = #{status}, memo = #{memo} WHERE id = #{id}
